full_prompt_en: A square classical landscape painting shows a pale stag standing in a lush rocky foreground beneath distant snow-covered mountains. The animal occupies the lower center-left, body turned to the right while its head angles slightly back toward the viewer. Broad branching antlers rise above its dark neck, and its cream coat catches a soft patch of light against the deep green vegetation. Low shrubs, ferns, moss, scattered pale rocks, and a small winding stream or wet path fill the lower half. Dark trees gather at the right edge and form a natural frame. Beyond them, a green valley recedes between steep shadowed mountains on both sides. At the far center, a sharp white summit rises under a break in the clouds, with smaller snow ridges falling away to either side. The sky is turbulent: heavy blue-gray cloud masses cover the left and upper edge, while pale sunlight opens around the peak at center-right. The foreground is rendered with finely layered foliage and broken rock texture; distant slopes are smoother and more atmospheric. Cool daylight from the cloud opening illuminates the summit and stag, leaving the nearer trees and valley sides deep olive and charcoal. The palette holds muted forest greens, blue-grays, warm creams, and a few pale yellow highlights. The antlers echo the jagged mountain outline, connecting the close animal to the vast background. The composition balances an intimate wildlife focal point with a dramatic, receding alpine space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典风景画呈现一头浅色雄鹿立在丰茂岩石前景，远处是积雪山峰。鹿占下部中央偏左，身体朝右，头略向观者回转。宽阔分叉鹿角从深色脖颈上升，奶油色皮毛在深绿植被前接到一片柔光。低矮灌木、蕨、苔、零散浅石以及一条弯曲小溪或湿小径填满下半幅。深树聚在右缘，构成天然围框。其后绿色山谷在两侧陡峭暗山之间后退。远方中央，一座尖白峰从云间升起，较小雪脊向两边落下。天空翻涌：厚蓝灰云团遮住左侧和上缘，浅日光则在中央偏右峰顶周围打开。前景枝叶与碎岩肌理层层细绘；远坡更平顺、更有空气感。云隙冷日光照亮雪峰和雄鹿，让近树与谷侧保留深橄榄和炭灰。配色含低饱和森林绿、蓝灰、暖奶油色及少量浅黄高光。鹿角呼应锯齿山线，把近处动物与广阔背景联系起来。构图平衡亲密野生动物焦点与戏剧化后退的高山空间。
style_prompt_en: A classical oil-painted landscape places a small luminous cream focal form within densely layered forest greens and blue-gray distance. Foreground detail is textured with short botanical strokes, broken rock edges, and dark mossy patches; receding slopes soften through cool haze. A jagged pale upper focal line rises at the horizon beneath heavy cloud masses, creating a second point of light. Directional daylight breaks through the clouds and picks out cream surfaces and snowlike ridges, while nearer framing shapes stay deep olive and charcoal. Broad atmospheric sweeps in the sky contrast with fine near-ground marks. Space opens through overlapping dark margins, a central valley-like recess, and progressively lighter distant planes. The palette is restrained and natural, with warm pale highlights balancing cool shadow. The rhythm alternates quiet close detail with monumental distant forms.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画风景把小块发亮奶油色焦点放在密集层叠的森林绿与蓝灰远景中。前景以短植物状笔触、破碎岩边和深色苔斑上肌理；后退坡面在冷雾中变软。一道锯齿浅色上部焦点线从厚云下的地平线升起，形成第二处亮点。定向日光破云而出，挑亮奶油色表面和雪状凸脊，近处围框形体仍是深橄榄与炭灰。天空宽阔空气笔触与近地细小痕迹对照。空间靠深色边缘遮叠、中央凹入和逐渐变浅的远方平面打开。配色克制自然，以暖浅高光平衡冷阴影。节奏在安静近景细节与宏大远方体量之间交替。
theme_en: A pale stag in a green mountain valley beneath snow peaks
theme_zh: 雪峰下绿色山谷中的浅色雄鹿
name: Edwin Landseer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
